visible_regressions: Light carrier outlines reduce dark structural contrast and make deck detail flatter.
Terrain outline is more varied but some bends are visibly polygonal; rock clusters form repeated rows.
improvements: Irregular shoreline and grouped rocks/trees add environmental variety.
top3_gaps: Replace single-curve foam dashes with irregular overlapping soft foam patches and varied shore contact.
Preserve dark contact/occlusion on carrier structures while using pale highlights selectively; uniform light outlines do not substitute for depth.
Player location ring works, but silhouette overlap and grainy smoke remain during dense combat; ocean and wake patterns repeat.
_summary.blinding_limitations: All25 images individually viewed. Only own prior records used to preserve anchors. No key/implementation/other judges inspected; recognizable scene families limit identity blinding.
